name: Parts Archive — renders motorcycle parts showcase cards, images, and detail dialog
description: Verifies that the Parts Archive section displays engineering component cards with images, and clicking View Detail opens the modal dialog.

planSteps.description: Navigate to '/#parts-archive' and ensure the '#parts-archive' section is scrolled into view
The section label 'ENGINEERED IN EVERY DETAIL' and heading 'EVERY PART HAS A PURPOSE.' are visible
Component showcase cards exist for 'J-SERIES ENGINE', 'TUNED PEASHOOTER', 'SIGNATURE HEADLIGHT', 'SCULPTED TANK', and 'SCULPTED SADDLE'
Each component card displays a transparent part image, subtitle, and performance stat line
Click the 'VIEW DETAIL' button '#btn-detail-engine' for the J-Series Engine
A modal dialog appears displaying comprehensive engineering specifications and service details for 'J-SERIES ENGINE'
Click the modal close button '#btn-close-parts-modal' or press the Escape key
The modal closes and the Parts Archive showcase '#parts-archive' is visible again
